statement: Tr MP+Nunchuk with default built-in inactive identity and re-attach on passes the kernel-bound gate: mode 05, two driven values on all three evdev gyro axes and 93 same-capture xwiimote MotionPlus events. No A400F0/A600F0 reinitialisation in the first 18 seconds after mapping; first such writes occur at reader-close cleanup after 22.2 seconds. Software regression only, no physical timing, child-controls or factory-calibration claim.

applicability.revision: Tr / virtual Wii Remote Plus PID 0330; physical revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. W9h controlled local virtual-host experiment, synthetic imported calibration and explicit binding/creation flags. Independent decoded oracle is separate from raw frames; no physical/radio/game/release/timing or whole-controller qualification. #258 gates generic-binding release use.
